proprio.layout: ang_vel3 | projected_gravity3 | cmd3 | joint_pos_rel12 | joint_vel_rel12 | last_action12

control.recurrent_semantics: zero on entry/reset/fault; feed each output state into the matching next-frame input

depth.normalization: meters in (0,5) divided by 5; <=0, >=5, NaN and Inf map to 0

acquisition.semantic: raw capture only; every accepted profile must use its runtime intrinsics and be reprojected to depth.shape

extrinsics.note: training reference only; live D435i mount must be measured before arm

safety.startup_shadow: startup_shadow_enabled=false by default: LT+X resets recurrent state and the first valid inference frame begins the synchronized command/action/last_action closed loop; setting it true restores the explicit stationary stability/time diagnostic gate
safety.suspended_test_mode: --suspended-test is accepted only with --fixed-zero --arm; it bypasses the optional startup gate when explicitly enabled, audits motion after clip/physical-limit/slew, and preserves tracking, freshness, inference, mechanical, stale-target, and takeover watchdogs
safety.ground_test_mode: --ground-test is accepted only with --fixed-zero --arm and cannot combine with --suspended-test; it bypasses the optional startup gate when explicitly enabled and disables the tracking-error soft gate while preserving post-slew step, freshness, inference, physical, velocity, torque, temperature, stale-target, and takeover guards
safety.fixed_vx_walk_mode: --fixed-vx --vx VALUE --arm accepts finite forward commands from 0 through 1.00 m/s; with the default startup configuration it publishes from the first valid post-reset inference frame, audits only the post-slew applied target step, and disables the tracking-error soft gate; physical limits, freshness, inference, velocity, torque, temperature, stale-target, and takeover guards remain active
safety.torque_guard: motor-reported torque above 14 Nm for hip/thigh or 27 Nm for calf is warning-only; torque SoftStop is disabled by matching its thresholds to the hard-fault boundaries; values above 22 Nm for hip/thigh or 43 Nm for calf still request immediate hard-fault takeover
safety.depth_health_policy: warning-only: missing first frame, stale/stopped frames, whole-image invalid fraction, and central-third invalid fraction never request takeover or block policy publication; successful RealSense pipeline startup is the only camera gate, and the latest frame (or initialized zero tensor before the first frame) remains the policy input
safety.depth_fault_capture: keep the latest 90 unique 320x180 projected depth frames in memory; the first depth-health warning requests a visloco_diag_TIMESTAMP_depth_warning dump after normal exit without takeover; --record-depth also requests the same dump after a normal powered-mode exit
safety.persistent_fault_log: each non-preflight run writes strict_controller_TIMESTAMP.log beside the VisionLoco CSV; FSM transitions and structured FAULT_SNAPSHOT, MECHANICAL_LIMIT, DEPTH_WARNING, LOWSTATE_FAULT, POLICY_TARGET_STALE, and BAD_ORIENTATION records are persisted and warning-or-higher records are flushed immediately
safety.fault_takeover: freeze policy target -> clear command/recurrent/last_action -> request Passive/FixStand -> prohibit stale target publication
